package.name: swerve_drive
package.description: Twist -> swerve-module mixing for simulated swerve robots: one body-frame geometry_msgs/Twist in, a position command per steer joint and a velocity command per drive wheel out, with the standard nearest-branch flip optimisation. The module geometry (positions, zero-steer headings, topics) is all parameters, so any swerve model works. This is a drive MIXER, not a teleop: pair it with a Twist source (revhub's motion_control for holonomic joystick driving) and ros_gz_bridge to reach the simulator.
